title: Idea run vector pass: suggestions reach Machines on Machines (suggest-backlog task, parked unindexable References)
description: Live run 2026-11-03: indexed 11, suggestionsWritten 0, suggestionsRemaining 8123. 42 s of the 119 s vector slice before the first Reference; then a walk of 3,464 unindexable References (25/s) in API order that never ends, so suggestions never start. Fix: suggestions first and independent of the sync, parked/owed memory in the router table, sync in plan order, set-based id filter, hourly suggest-backlog task (FAN_OUT_TASKS), per-step timings in the log line.
